xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4634: CLIProxy v7.3.16 does not serve gpt-6.1-terra: bump the pin and add Terra to the claude-code route

plan.title: CLIProxy v7.3.16 does not serve gpt-6.1-terra: bump the pin and add Terra to the claude-code route
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-4633 left gpt-6.1-terra off the claude-code route because the pinned CLIProxy 7.3.16 answered 'unknown provider for model gpt-6.1-terra' on 2026-10-26. The code, the capability notes and the docs still say Terra is Codex-harness only and that a pin bump is pending.
narratives.Proposal: A 2026-11-11 re-probe shows the same pinned 7.3.16 binary (no binary or config change) now lists and serves gpt-6.1-terra under ChatGPT sign-in: POST /v1/messages returned a completion and a claude --print tool round trip at the 272K pin succeeded. CLIProxy refreshes its model catalog every 3h from router-for-me/models models.json, which added Terra on 2026-10-26T23:15Z, after the PAN-4633 probe. So: keep the pin at v7.3.16, add gpt-6.1-terra to GPT_56_MODELS (behavior-neutral: the capability fallthrough already yields 272000/272000), replace the negative-probe notes in cliproxy.ts and model-capability-additions.ts with the dated positive probe, and update configuration/harnesses.mdx and the v0.78.0 Upcoming changelog block. See .pan/drafts/PAN-4634.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Bumping CLIPROXY_RELEASE_VERSION or evaluating CLIProxyAPI 8.x
- Fixing gpt-6-sol or gpt-5.6-terra on the claude-code route (both return 'unknown provider' today) or removing them from GPT_56_MODELS
- Changing the oauth-model-alias remaps (which rename gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra and gpt-6-sol to Claude ids and so hide the original ids) or adding fork to them
- Adding gpt-6-rosalind, gpt-6-astra-law or gpt-6-chat-thinking to GPT_56_MODELS or any route
- Adding a harness-policy gate that refuses claude-code + any OpenAI model
- Adding a [372k] variant for Terra, or changing defaults, presets, tiers or role models
- Adding a test that reads provider-env.ts or cliproxy.ts as source text
- Editing the shipped Terra changelog entry near changelog.mdx:205 or .pan/backlog/sequence.md

autoDecisions.summary: No CLIProxy pin bump: CLIPROXY_RELEASE_VERSION stays 'v7.3.16'
autoDecisions.rationale: Probed 2026-11-11: the running process (/proc/21217/exe -> ~/.overdeck/bin/cliproxy, 'CLIProxyAPI Version: 7.3.16, Commit: c404af96') lists gpt-6.1-terra in GET /v1/models and POST /v1/messages returns a completion; config.yaml and config.extra.yaml contain no 6.1-terra mapping. cliproxy.log shows a 3-hourly refresh from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/router-for-me/models/refs/heads/main/models.json, which lists gpt-6.1-terra (added 2026-10-26T23:15:19Z). The issue scope allows 'the CLIProxy version (or config) that serves' Terra, and the issue itself suspected the model list did not come from a static per-version table. A 7.x to 8.x major jump would risk the version banner, oauth-model-alias and management API for no gain.

autoDecisions.summary: Add gpt-6.1-terra to GPT_56_MODELS even though the launch env does not change
autoDecisions.rationale: Terra's capability contextWindow is already CLIPROXY_GPT56_CONTEXT_WINDOW, so the fallthrough already exports 272000/272000. Membership makes the route explicit and matches the issue's scope item 2. The existing model-capabilities.test.ts env-export case for gpt-6.1-terra proves the result; no source-reading test is added.

autoDecisions.summary: List GPT-6.1 Sol alongside Terra in the harnesses.mdx 272K sentence
autoDecisions.rationale: gpt-6.1-sol is already in GPT_56_MODELS but missing from that sentence; adding only Terra would leave the sentence wrong in a new way.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a v0.78.0 Upcoming changelog bullet and leave the shipped Terra entry unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: The shipped entry is release history; the Upcoming block is where unreleased user-facing changes go per the RELEASE STEP comment in changelog.mdx.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep gpt-6-rosalind and gpt-6-astra-law out of GPT_56_MODELS
autoDecisions.rationale: Neither appears in today's GET /v1/models list.
